title: Representasi Identitas Tokoh Anak Perempuan dalam Kumpulan Cerpen Kapan Nanti Karya Ziggy Zezsyazeoviennazabrizkie
text_snippet: Representasi Identitas Tokoh Anak Perempuan dalam Kumpulan Cerpen Kapan Nanti Karya Ziggy Zezsyazeoviennazabrizkie The perspectives of girls in adult literature are important to examine because they can reveal experiences of gender injustice through narrative strategies. However, studies integrating Gérard Genette's focalization theory and Judith Butler's gender performativity theory to examine the representation of girls in adult literature remain limited. This study aims to describe the construction of girls' perspectives and the representation of their gender identities in Ziggy Z's short story collection Kapan Nanti. This study employed a qualitative descriptive approach. The data consisted of narrative, descriptive, and dialogic excerpts collected through reading and note-taking techniques and analyzed using content analysis based on Genette’s (1980) focalization theory and Butler’s (2002) gender performativity theory. The findings show that zero focalization places girls' experiences within broader social contexts and power relations, internal focalization presents their experiences through the characters' consciousness and interpretation, while external focalization limits access to the characters' voices and inner experiences. title: Critical Discourse Analysis of Horror-Comedy Interdiscursivity: Linguistic Demystification of Javanese Myths in Sekawan Limo (2024)
text_snippet: Critical Discourse Analysis of Horror-Comedy Interdiscursivity: Linguistic Demystification of Javanese Myths in Sekawan Limo (2024) Employing Norman Fairclough's three-dimensional Critical Discourse Analysis, this study examines how the East Javanese Arekan dialect linguistically demystifies spiritual fear in the horror-comedy film Sekawan Limo (2024). Prior sociolinguistic research has largely confined Javanese speech variation to reflections of feudal hierarchy, overlooking how regional dialects are deployed by youth to negotiate mysticism in the digital era. Existing studies on this specific film have likewise mapped its illocutionary speech acts and code-mixing patterns, but none has traced how its dialect performs the demystification of mystical hegemony across textual, industrial, and sociocultural dimensions at once. The objective of this study is to deconstruct how discursive friction between urban rationality and traditional mysticism is linguistically negotiated across the textual, discursive-practice, and social-practice dimensions of this framework. title: Representasi Aktor dan Ideologi Krisis Rupiah pada Media Digital: Analisis Wacana Kritis Berita CNN Indonesia
text_snippet: Representasi Aktor dan Ideologi Krisis Rupiah pada Media Digital: Analisis Wacana Kritis Berita CNN Indonesia The depreciation of the Indonesian rupiah to Rp17,700 per US dollar in May 2026 attracted intensive coverage from Indonesian digital media, including CNN Indonesia on YouTube. This study analyzes the discourse of the broadcast entitled Rupiah Anjlok Tembus Rp17.700/US$ dan IHSG Melorot, Ada Apa? (May 19, 2026) using Norman Fairclough's three-dimensional framework of text, discursive practice, and social practice, augmented by Theo van Leeuwen's social actor representation taxonomy. As an audio-visual object, the broadcast's linguistic data were obtained through verbatim transcription of all utterances, indexed into 12 time-stamped segments; visual and prosodic dimensions are acknowledged but methodologically delimited outside the analytical corpus. The study aims to: (1) identify the linguistic representation of the rupiah crisis at the textual dimension; (2) analyze discursive practices underlying the production and distribution of the discourse; (3) reveal ideology and power relations within the social practice dimension; and (4) describe the representation of six primary social actors, namely Bank Indonesia, the Indonesian government, foreign investors, the general public, globa

title: Revitalisasi Tradisi Lisan Pekanbaru Melalui Model Telusur Kultur
text_snippet: Revitalisasi Tradisi Lisan Pekanbaru Melalui Model Telusur Kultur The origin of the name “Teluk Leok” in the Limbungan neighborhood is a crucial pillar of Malay cultural knowledge that is now threatened with extinction due to modernization and a lack of documentation. This study aims to document, analyze, and revitalize this narrative so that it remains relevant as the collective identity of the local community. The method used is qualitative, involving field documentation through the Telusur Kultur, which integrates observation, in-depth interviews with key informants such as Abdullah and Ujang S., and audiovisual documentation. Based on Abdullah’s account, the toponymy of Leok Bay is linked to the grounding and burning of the ship Akasia. This narrative also connects the name “Leok” to the figure of Captain Leo. The study’s conclusions affirm that the “Telusur Kultur” model is effective in preserving collective memory and transforming oral traditions into practical assets, both as educational materials and as a potential resource for storytelling tourism. The success of this preservation effort depends heavily on participatory collaboration among academics, the community, and the government.

title: Analisis Tindak Tutur dan Implikatur Drama Telaga Warna: Implikasi terhadap Pembelajaran Membaca Pemahaman Siswa Fase C
text_snippet: Analisis Tindak Tutur dan Implikatur Drama Telaga Warna: Implikasi terhadap Pembelajaran Membaca Pemahaman Siswa Fase C Reading comprehension instruction for Phase C students must aim beyond identifying explicit information to grasping implicit meaning and context. The Telaga Warna drama script contains rich character dialogues reflecting conflicts, emotional responses, and distinct traits, making it ideal for developing these skills. However, studies integrating speech acts and implicatures in this script for Phase C learning remain limited. This descriptive qualitative study analyzes speech acts and implicatures in Telaga Warna and their pedagogical implications. Character dialogues were examined through data condensation, coding, presentation, contextual analysis, and verification. Findings show the script features locutionary, illocutionary, and perlocutionary speech acts, alongside pragmatic implicatures. Locutionary acts dominate, primarily conveying direct information, while perlocutionary acts are least frequent due to requiring deeper contextual interpretation. The implicatures demonstrate that understanding dialogues extends beyond literal meaning, requiring connections between utterances, situations, and interpersonal dynamics. title: Pengembangan Bahan Ajar Digital BIPA Berbasis Kearifan Lokal Sumatera Utara Melalui Media Flipbook untuk Pembelajar Tingkat Pemula di UIN Sumatera Utara
text_snippet: Pengembangan Bahan Ajar Digital BIPA Berbasis Kearifan Lokal Sumatera Utara Melalui Media Flipbook untuk Pembelajar Tingkat Pemula di UIN Sumatera Utara Indonesian Language for Foreign Speakers (BIPA) instruction plays a strategic role in introducing the Indonesian language and culture to the international community. However, beginner-level BIPA instruction still faces challenges, particularly the limited availability of learning media that are interactive, contextual, and grounded in local culture. Preliminary observations and interviews with BIPA instructors at Universitas Islam Negeri Sumatera Utara revealed that the use of digital media in BIPA instruction remains limited and has not fully integrated the local wisdom of North Sumatra. This study aims to develop a Flipbook incorporating the local wisdom of North Sumatra as an alternative teaching material that is interactive, communicative, and contextual for beginner-level BIPA students, as well as to examine its feasibility and effectiveness. The study employed a Research and Development (R&D) method using the ADDIE model (Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, Evaluation). title: Variasi Fonologis dan Leksikal Bahasa Melayu di Kampung Tua, Sungai Mempura, Siak
text_snippet: Variasi Fonologis dan Leksikal Bahasa Melayu di Kampung Tua, Sungai Mempura, Siak Siak Malay serves as a vital cultural symbol reflecting the historical identity and ecological adaptation of the Riau community. Although numerous dialectological studies on Malay have been conducted, research focusing on the dynamics of local isolects and intergenerational lexical shift patterns in the historical area of the former Siak Sultanate remains limited. This study aims to describe and analyze the phonological variations, ecological lexical characteristics, and sociolinguistic differentiations in the Malay language spoken in Kampung Tua, Sungai Mempura Village, Siak Regency. A qualitative descriptive dialectological approach was employed, involving nine native informants across three observation points (TP). Data were gathered through observation, elicitation, interview, recording, and note-taking techniques using a modified Swadesh word list. The results indicate that phonological variations are dominated by the vowel shift /a/→[o] in open-word final positions (gulo [gulo], apo [apo]), the realization of the phoneme /r/ as a voiced velar fricative [γ] (ghotan [ɣotan]), and sound deletion (elision). title: Representasi Simbol ‘Hantu’ dalam Novel Tentang Kamu Karya Tere Liye (Kajian Semiotika).
text_snippet: Representasi Simbol ‘Hantu’ dalam Novel Tentang Kamu Karya Tere Liye (Kajian Semiotika). This study examines the representation of the 'ghost' symbol in Tere Liye’s novel Tentang Kamu and its function in Sri Ningsih’s character development. Specifically, it aims to describe how the 'ghost' symbol is represented and explain its role in shaping the protagonist’s narrative arc. Employing a descriptive qualitative design, this research utilizes Charles Sanders Peirce’s triadic semiotics, focusing on the symbol category as a sign system that operates beyond visual resemblance (icon) or direct causal connection (index). Within this framework, the 'ghost' symbol is analyzed as a representament pointing to a specific object and generating an interpretant shaped by narrative context and cultural consensus. Textual data comprising words, phrases, and sentences from the novel were collected through close reading and note-taking, and subsequently analyzed through identification, classification, functional interpretation, and synthesis. The findings reveal that the 'ghost' symbol does not denote a supernatural entity, but rather manifests trauma, guilt, and lingering memories that haunt Sri Ningsih, specifically referencing the character Sulastri. title: Kekuasaan dan Ideologi dalam Novel Namaku Alam Karya Leila S. Chudori: Analisis Wacana Kritis Teun A. Van Dijk
text_snippet: Kekuasaan dan Ideologi dalam Novel Namaku Alam Karya Leila S. Chudori: Analisis Wacana Kritis Teun A. Van Dijk Novels serve not only as entertainment but also as a reflection of the social dynamics, power structures, and ideologies of their time. Research on the novel Namaku Alam has been limited to studies in literary sociology and psychology, so few have critically examined the construction of power and ideology through language. This study aims to analyze the construction of power and ideology in the novel Namaku Alam by Leila S. Chudori. This study employs a descriptive qualitative approach using the critical discourse analysis model of Teun A. Van Dijk. The research data consists of quotations of words, sentences, dialogues, and paragraphs that contain elements of power and ideology. The results of the study indicate that (1) at the textual level, three dominant discourses are constructed: power as a tool for manipulating history, the stigmatization of anti-communist ideology as an instrument of social control, and corruption as a naturalized status symbol; (2) at the social cognition dimension, the author reflects a critical-humanist ideology through counter-hegemonic narratives to reclaim collective memory from state power; (3) at the social context dimension, the historical New Orde

title: Fenomena Perilaku Psikopat dalam Novel Badan Intelijen Sekolah 2 Siapa Dalangnya? Karya Intanzs: Kajian Psikologi Sastra
text_snippet: Fenomena Perilaku Psikopat dalam Novel Badan Intelijen Sekolah 2 Siapa Dalangnya? Karya Intanzs: Kajian Psikologi Sastra This study aims to describe the forms and factors related to psychopathic behavior in the novel School Intelligence Agency 2 Who is the Mastermind? by IntanZS. This study uses a literary psychology approach with the characteristics of Robert D. Hare's psychopathy as the basis for analysis. The source of the research is the novel, while the data is in the form of novel quotes that show the psychopathic behavior of the characters. The results of the study show that there are several forms of psychopathic behavior in the characters, namely antisocial, manipulative, aggressive, sadistic behavior, and lack of remorse and guilt. Antisocial behavior is shown through the tendency to violate norms and threaten the safety of others. Manipulative behavior is seen through the use of beliefs, lies, and the act of trapping others to achieve certain goals. Aggressive behavior is shown through physical violence and verbal threats. Sadistic behavior is represented through acts of violence and a series of deaths that cause suffering to the victim. title: Exploring Sound Change and Language Kinship: A Literature Study from The Perspective of Historical and Comparative Linguistics
text_snippet: Exploring Sound Change and Language Kinship: A Literature Study from The Perspective of Historical and Comparative Linguistics Research on sound change, language kinship, and protolanguage reconstruction in Indonesia remains limited, given the number of existing languages. The purpose of this study is to explore the results of studies published over the last 10 years (2015–2025) and to identify the application of theory and methodology, as well as their consequences. The PRISMA method employs multiple pertinent keywords for its search. Articles were retrieved from Sinta and Publish or Perish (POP). After screening and eligibility, 24 of 245 publications were selected for comprehensive analysis. The results indicate that sound change occurs regularly and has a pattern. The analysis of language kinship, based on lexicostatistical and glottochronological methods, reveals various levels of language grouping, from the language-family level to the macrophylum, with an estimated separation time of thousands of years. title: Behind The Humor: Implicatures in Stand-Up Comedy Mens Rea
text_snippet: Behind The Humor: Implicatures in Stand-Up Comedy Mens Rea Stand-up comedy serves not only as entertainment but also as an indirect means of conveying sensitive sociopolitical criticism to the public. This study examines how maxim flouting generates conversational implicatures to convey humor and sociopolitical criticism in the stand-up comedy show Mens Rea. It aims to identify the forms of maxim flouting and conversational implicature found in the show. The study is expected to contribute to the development of pragmatic studies, particularly in understanding the use of conversational implicature in humorous discourse as a medium for conveying sociopolitical criticism. A qualitative descriptive approach was adopted, with utterances that flouted the maxims serving as the primary data source. Data collection was conducted through observation and documentation, by recording Mens Rea’s stand-up comedy shows on Netflix. The recordings were transcribed into text to facilitate data analysis. Data analysis was conducted using descriptive qualitative methods to identify and interpret flouts of maxims, which reveal the implicit meanings of these utterances, guided by Grice’s (1975) theoretical framework. title: Politik Marjinalitas dan Agensi Tokoh dalam Cerpen Pilihan Dalang Publishing: Kajian Poskolonial, Feminisme, dan Ekokritik
text_snippet: Politik Marjinalitas dan Agensi Tokoh dalam Cerpen Pilihan Dalang Publishing: Kajian Poskolonial, Feminisme, dan Ekokritik Contemporary literary works can serve as a space for critiquing various forms of injustice and power relations. However, previous studies tend to examine postcolonial, gender, and environmental issues separately, so the connections among these issues in the representation of marginalization have received less attention. This study aims to analyze the representation of the politics of marginalization as well as the forms of agency and resistance strategies of characters in three short stories published by Dalang Publishing: Impian Sulastri by G. Budi Subanar, Rolin by Purwanti Kusumaningtyas, and Kepak Sayap Tekukur Hunai by Maria Teodora Ping. This qualitative study employs critical textual analysis based on Critical Literary Theory and draws on postcolonial, feminist, and ecocritical perspectives. The data consist of narratives, dialogues, monologues, and setting descriptions, which were analyzed through close reading. title: Rhetorical Strategies in Indra Kenz’s Binomo Promotion: A Forensic Linguistic Analysis
text_snippet: Rhetorical Strategies in Indra Kenz’s Binomo Promotion: A Forensic Linguistic Analysis The rapid expansion of social media has transformed digital platforms into influential spaces for promoting financial products and shaping investment decisions through persuasive communication. This development raises a linguistic problem in digital investment fraud, as persuasive messages can construct credibility, influence audience perceptions, and encourage financial decisions through rhetorical and pragmatic strategies that may obscure deceptive meanings. Drawing on Aristotle’s rhetorical appeals of ethos, pathos, and logos (2007), Searle’s Speech Act Theory (1969), Grice’s Conversational Implicature Theory (1975), and forensic linguistic principles, this study aims to analyze the rhetorical and pragmatic strategies employed in Indra Kenz’s Binomo promotional discourse and explain their significance as linguistic evidence. The study provides insights into linguistic indicators of deceptive financial promotion that may support forensic analysis, fraud prevention, and media literacy. title: Mimicry and Hybridity in Nkem’s Identity Transformation in Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie’s Imitation
text_snippet: Mimicry and Hybridity in Nkem’s Identity Transformation in Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie’s Imitation Postcolonial literature provides a significant space for examining how diasporic subjects negotiate cultural identity across different social and cultural environments. Although previous studies of Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie’s Imitation have addressed displacement, resistance, cultural ambivalence, and linguistic negotiation, limited attention has been given to the processual relationship between mimicry and hybridity in Nkem’s identity transformation. This study examines the representation of mimicry and hybridity in Imitation and explains how these interconnected processes contribute to the negotiation of Nkem’s postcolonial identity. Employing a qualitative literary research design, the study applies textual analysis guided by Homi K. Bhabha’s concepts of mimicry, ambivalence, hybridity, and the Third Space. Data were collected through close reading and textual documentation and analyzed through indicator-based coding. title: Pengembangan Game Edukasi Berbasis Blooket untuk Meningkatkan Keterampilan Menulis Teks Berita
text_snippet: Pengembangan Game Edukasi Berbasis Blooket untuk Meningkatkan Keterampilan Menulis Teks Berita This study aims to develop an educational game using the Blooket platform to improve the news writing skills of seventh-grade students at SMP PAB 21 Pematang Johar. This research applies the Research and Development (R&D) approach through the ADDIE model, which consists of the stages of analysis, design, development, implementation, and evaluation. Meanwhile, data collection is carried out using observation, interviews, questionnaires, and tests. The instruments used in this study include validation sheets from media experts, material experts, language experts, response questionnaires from teachers and students, as well as pretests, posttest and N-Gain tests. This study involved 25 students from the seventh grade at SMP PAB 21 Pematang Johar. The findings of this study indicate that Blooket-based educational games received validation of 97% from media experts, 91% from material experts, and 85% from language experts, all of which fall into the very feasible category. Student responses to the media reached 88% and teacher responses were around 90%, also in the very good category. title: Hate Speech in The Comment Section of The X Account of The Minister of The Republic of Indonesia
text_snippet: Hate Speech in The Comment Section of The X Account of The Minister of The Republic of Indonesia The X account of the Minister of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM) of the Republic of Indonesia is intended to function as a medium of public information and transparency; however, its comment section frequently becomes a space for the dissemination of hate speech. This study aims to identify and describe the forms of hate speech in the comment section of the minister’s X account using Searle’s theory of illocutionary speech acts. This study employed a qualitative descriptive method. The data consisted of 42 hate-speech comments (N = 42) collected from comments posted on the Minister of Energy and Mineral Resources’ X account in response to a post published on September 17, 2025. Data were collected using non-participant observation (SBLC), documentation, and purposive sampling, and were analyzed using linguistic and contextual analysis. The findings reveal four types of illocutionary speech acts: expressive (27 data; 60%), directive (9 data; 20%), assertive (8 data; 18%), and commissive (1 data; 2%), while no declarative speech acts were identified. title: Formulasi dan Kesantunan Tindak Tutur Izin ke Kamar Mandi dalam Bahasa Indonesia
text_snippet: Formulasi dan Kesantunan Tindak Tutur Izin ke Kamar Mandi dalam Bahasa Indonesia Asking for permission to go to the bathroom is a common linguistic practice in daily interactions, yet it carries complex pragmatic implications as it involves both individual needs and the orderliness of social interaction. This study aims to describe the formulation of bathroom permission speech acts in Indonesian and the pragmatic impact of these formulations on interaction. The study focuses on lexical variations, speech forms and structures, politeness strategies, and the acceptability of utterances across various interactional contexts. A qualitative approach with field research methods was employed. Oral data of bathroom permission utterances were collected through Discourse Completion Tasks (DCT), in-depth interviews, and covert field experiment. The data were analyzed using descriptive pragmatics, considering the speech situation, formulation structure, and the hearer's response. The results indicate that bathroom permission formulations are dominated by euphemistic locational references with the three most dominant lexicons being ke belakang (going to the back), ke kamar mandi (going to the bathroom), and toilet, and realized through indirect speech. title: Strategi Kesantunan Guru dalam Pembelajaran sebagai Penanaman Etika Komunikasi Siswa Sekolah Dasar
text_snippet: Strategi Kesantunan Guru dalam Pembelajaran sebagai Penanaman Etika Komunikasi Siswa Sekolah Dasar Research on teacher politeness strategies generally focuses on linguistic forms in classroom interactions, while studies linking these strategies to cultivating students' communication ethics in primary school Indonesian language learning remain limited. This study aims to describe the teacher's language politeness strategies and uncover the cultivation of students' communication ethics through these strategies. A qualitative case study approach was applied at SDN 01 Gawanan Colomadu, involving a third-grade teacher and students. Data were collected through observations of classroom interactions, semi-structured interviews with the teacher, and documentation of teaching modules and video recordings. Data analysis involved reduction, coding of positive and negative politeness utterances, thematic presentation, and drawing conclusions via triangulation. The results showed that the teacher’s politeness strategies included collective greetings, inclusive pronouns, specific praise, empathetic politeness markers, indirect instructions, softening particles, and personal reprimands without negative labeling. title: Representasi Nilai Sosial dan Pembentukan Karakter dalam Novel Hujan Bulan Juni Karya Sapardi Djoko Damono: Analisis Thomas Lickona
text_snippet: Representasi Nilai Sosial dan Pembentukan Karakter dalam Novel Hujan Bulan Juni Karya Sapardi Djoko Damono: Analisis Thomas Lickona This study aims to analyze the representation of social values in Hujan Bulan Juni, a novel by Sapardi Djoko Damono, through Thomas Lickona’s character education framework. A descriptive qualitative approach was employed using close reading and content analysis of the novel’s narrative, dialogues, and event descriptions. The data were analyzed through the stages of identification, coding, classification, interpretation, and conclusion drawing based on the three components of morality: moral knowing, moral feeling, and moral action. The findings reveal that the cultural conflict between Javanese and Minahasan identities, religious differences, and family expectations constitute the primary factors shaping the representation of social values in the novel. Moral knowing is reflected in the protagonists’ awareness of cultural norms, religious values, and social responsibilities. Moral feeling is expressed through anxiety, inner conflict, and emotional struggles arising from the tension between personal desires and social expectations. title: Krisis Ekologi dan Etika Ekologis dalam Novel Teruslah Bodoh Jangan Pintar Karya Tere Liye
text_snippet: Krisis Ekologi dan Etika Ekologis dalam Novel Teruslah Bodoh Jangan Pintar Karya Tere Liye The escalation of the ecological crisis caused by massive extractive industrial activities necessitates the strengthening of environmental literacy through cultural media. This study aims to explore the representation of the ecological crisis and the dynamics of ecological ethics in Tere Liye’s novel Teruslah Bodoh Jangan Pintar using Greg Garrard’s ecocritical perspective. The research method employed is descriptive qualitative with content analysis techniques. The results indicate that the novel reconstructs the ecological crisis based on the three primary pillars of Greg Garrard's ecocriticism, namely: pollution as structural violence, dwelling as landscape alienation, and local apocalypse as a consequence of reclamation failure. These findings reveal a dialectic in the community's ecological ethics, shifting from a passive stance to a reactive collective advocacy movement in response to environmental repression. The novelty of this research lies in its focus on contemporary popular literature that deconstructs the conflicts of the modern mining industry, while affirming the role of popular novels as effective instruments for socio-ecological critique in Indonesia.

title: Leksikostatistik dan Glotokronologi Bahasa Melayu Palembang, Jambi, dan Riau Kepulauan
text_snippet: Leksikostatistik dan Glotokronologi Bahasa Melayu Palembang, Jambi, dan Riau Kepulauan Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengukur persentase kekerabatan kognat, mengestimasi jangka waktu perpisahan (time depth), serta merekonstruksi silsilah kebahasaan (subgrouping) antara Bahasa Melayu Palembang (BMP), Bahasa Melayu Jambi (BMJ), dan Bahasa Melayu Riau Kepulauan (BMRK) melalui pendekatan linguistik historis komparatif. Menggunakan instrumen 300 kosakata dasar Swadesh-Keraf. Data lapangan diperoleh melalui metode simak dan cakap dari penutur asli berkriteria Nonmobile, Older, Rural, Males (NORMs) di wilayah periferi situs-situs bersejarah Melayu. Analisis kualitatif dioperasionalkan melalui teknik Pilah Unsur Penentu (PUP), Hubung Banding Menyamakan (HBS), dan Hubung Banding Membedakan (HBB), yang selanjutnya dikuantifikasi menggunakan formula leksikostatistik, glotokronologi Swadesh, serta kriteria pengelompokan Dyen. Hasil analisis leksikostatistik menunjukkan persentase kekerabatan kognat tertinggi terdapat pada pasangan BMJ–BMRK, sebesar 86,67% (87%), disusul pasangan BMP–BMJ sebesar 80,67% (81%), dan pasangan BMP–BMRK sebesar 78,67% (79%). title: Pengembangan Media Pembelajaran Monopoli untuk Meningkatkan Kemampuan Menulis Teks Anekdot bagi Siswa Kelas X MAN Dairi
text_snippet: Pengembangan Media Pembelajaran Monopoli untuk Meningkatkan Kemampuan Menulis Teks Anekdot bagi Siswa Kelas X MAN Dairi Writing ability is the pinnacle of productive language skills and is also a major challenge for students. The gap in the field shows a mismatch between curriculum demands and the reality at MAN Dairi, where the interest and ability of grade X students in writing anecdotal texts are still relatively low due to the use of conventional and monotonous learning media. This study aims to develop, validate, and test the practicality and effectiveness of modified monopoly learning media as an interactive solution in improving anecdotal text writing skills. The method applied in this study is Research and Development (R&D) with a development model following the 4D stages (Define, Design, Development, and Dissemination). The main findings show that the developed monopoly media meets the criteria for being very feasible based on expert validation with an average percentage of 88.3%. The results of the practicality test also showed a positive response with a percentage of 78.78% from students (practical category) and 90% from teachers (very practical category). title: Analisis Unsur Intrinsik Puisi dalam Kumpulan Puisi “Asmaraloka” Karya Usman Arrumy dan Rekomendasinya sebagai Bahan Ajar Apresiasi Puisi Tingkat SMA
text_snippet: Analisis Unsur Intrinsik Puisi dalam Kumpulan Puisi “Asmaraloka” Karya Usman Arrumy dan Rekomendasinya sebagai Bahan Ajar Apresiasi Puisi Tingkat SMA Poetry appreciation learning in high schools requires teaching materials that are aesthetic, easy to read, and relevant to students' experiences. However, poetry materials used in class often do not fully consider readability, thematic proximity, and the text's potential as a means of poetry appreciation. This study aims to analyze the intrinsic elements of poetry in Usman Arrumy's Asmaraloka poetry collection, which is relevant as open material for high school poetry appreciation. The study used a qualitative descriptive method with a content analysis design with a structural approach. Data collection techniques were through bibliography, reading, and recording. The research data consisted of 20 selected poems from 52 poems in Asmaraloka, selected based on theme variation, representation of physical and spiritual elements, and pedagogical relevance. Physical elements are divided into diction, imagery, concrete words, figurative language, verification, and typography, while spiritual elements consist of theme, feeling, tone, and message. title: Strategi Kesantunan Berbahasa Netizen Dalam Kolom Komentar di Media Sosial (Instagram Presiden Prabowo)
text_snippet: Strategi Kesantunan Berbahasa Netizen Dalam Kolom Komentar di Media Sosial (Instagram Presiden Prabowo) The development of social media as a public communication platform has generated diverse forms of linguistic interaction, including those occurring in the comment sections of official accounts belonging to public figures. However, the freedom of expression afforded by digital spaces is not always accompanied by the use of polite language. This study aims to analyze the linguistic politeness strategies employed by netizens in the Instagram comment section of President Prabowo's post commemorating International Workers' Day (Labour Day). A qualitative approach using content analysis was adopted in this study. The data consisted of netizens' comments, which were collected through documentation techniques and analyzed using Brown and Levinson's politeness strategy framework, encompassing bald on record, positive politeness, negative politeness, and off-record strategies. The findings reveal that, of the 986 comments analyzed, bald on record was the most dominant strategy, followed by off-record, negative politeness, and positive politeness. title: Kesantunan Berbahasa pada Tuturan Anggota DPR Terkait Isu Tunjangan dan Demonstrasi 2025 (Kajian Pragmatik)
text_snippet: Kesantunan Berbahasa pada Tuturan Anggota DPR Terkait Isu Tunjangan dan Demonstrasi 2025 (Kajian Pragmatik) The issue of salary increases for members of the House of Representatives often sparks public discourse involving the dynamics of politeness and impoliteness in language. This study aims to analyze compliance with and violations of the principles of politeness in the speech of House of Representatives members regarding the issue of salary increases and the wave of demonstrations in 2025. This study employs a qualitative descriptive approach using content analysis. Subsequently, the data were analyzed descriptively using percentage tabulations to identify dominant politeness maxim trends. Data sources were obtained from various social media platforms containing both official statements and opinions of DPR members. Data were collected through observation and note-taking of 265 speech units, which were then analyzed using the theoretical framework of politeness maxims. The research results indicate that adherence to the maxims of politeness still dominates at 61%, while violations of the maxims (impoliteness) account for 39%. title: Penerapan Media Interaktif Berbasis Gemini Canvas Melalui Interactive Flat Panel dalam Pembelajaran Membaca Cerita Rakyat Berbasis Kearifan Lokal Pada Siswa Kelas V SD Negeri 01 Dukuh
text_snippet: Penerapan Media Interaktif Berbasis Gemini Canvas Melalui Interactive Flat Panel dalam Pembelajaran Membaca Cerita Rakyat Berbasis Kearifan Lokal Pada Siswa Kelas V SD Negeri 01 Dukuh This study aims to describe the implementation of Gemini Canvas-based interactive media through an Interactive Flat Panel in teaching folklore reading based on local wisdom to elementary school students and its impact. A descriptive qualitative approach with a naturalistic design was employed. Data included reading activities, student interactions, engagement, evaluation results, and responses from both the teacher and students. Data were collected through observations of the learning process, aloud reading, group discussions, and interactive media usage; interviews with the fifth-grade teacher and students; and documentation of teaching modules, materials, worksheets, assessment instruments, and activity photos. Data sources consisted of the fifth-grade teacher, 15 fifth-grade students, and the reading instruction process at SD Negeri 01 Dukuh. Data validity was ensured using source and method triangulation. The interactive data analysis model involved data reduction, data display, and conclusion drawing. title: Strategi Asertif dalam Konstruksi Kritik dan Argumentasi pada Peristiwa Tutur Digital Podcast Malaka Project
text_snippet: Strategi Asertif dalam Konstruksi Kritik dan Argumentasi pada Peristiwa Tutur Digital Podcast Malaka Project The rise of podcasts as a digital communication medium has created a space for speakers to express criticism, viewpoints, and arguments through the use of assertive speech acts. This study aims to analyze the construction of criticism and argumentation through the use of assertive speech acts in the utterances of Bagus Muljadi and Ferry Irwandi in the Malaka Project podcast episode “Discussing Research, Education, and Mystical Logic with Bagus Muljadi.” This study employs a qualitative descriptive approach, with data collected through the technique of non-participatory listening, recording, and note-taking, while data validity is strengthened through the application of triangulation. The data were analyzed using the matching and distribution methods, supplemented by stages of reduction, presentation, and verification to ensure the accuracy of classification. The results of the study revealed 207 assertive speech acts, including 42 declarative utterances, 22 propositional utterances, 6 boastful utterances, 42 complaints, 59 expressions of opinion, and 36 reports. title: Analisis Kebutuhan Model Penilaian Menulis Berbasis STEM untuk Meningkatkan Keterampilan Berpikir Kritis Mahasiswa
text_snippet: Analisis Kebutuhan Model Penilaian Menulis Berbasis STEM untuk Meningkatkan Keterampilan Berpikir Kritis Mahasiswa 21st-century learning demands that universities produce human resources capable of critical, creative, and adaptive thinking in response to developments in science and technology. One important skill that needs to be developed in Indonesian language learning is critical thinking skills through academic writing activities. This study aims to analyze the need to develop a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics)-based writing assessment model to improve students' critical thinking skills. The type of research used is survey research with a descriptive qualitative and quantitative approach. The research instruments include interview guidelines, needs analysis questionnaires, learning observation sheets, and documentation. The study involved six Indonesian language lecturers and 68 students consisting of 40 female students and 28 male students. The results show that the writing assessment process applied is still conventional and focuses more on linguistic aspects than students' critical thinking skills. title: Dialektika Eksistensial Cinta dalam Kumpulan Puisi Sepotong Hati di Angkringan Karya Joko Pinurbo
text_snippet: Dialektika Eksistensial Cinta dalam Kumpulan Puisi Sepotong Hati di Angkringan Karya Joko Pinurbo The COVID-19 pandemic triggered an existential crisis that compelled individuals to rediscover spiritual and emotional foundations through the reinterpretation of love in literary works. This study examines the existential meaning of love in Joko Pinurbo's poetry collection Sepotong Hati di Angkringan, integrating two complementary theoretical frameworks: Erich Fromm's five objects of love in humanistic psychology (brotherly, maternal, erotic, self-love, and love of God) and Paul Ricoeur's three-stage hermeneutics (semantic, reflective, and ontological). This research employs a qualitative method based on library research with a hermeneutic content analysis design applied to seven purposively selected poems. At the semantic stage, the five objects of love were identified through lexical ambiguity and domestic imagery such as the clinking of a spoon, a drying sarong, and the ritual of bathing. At the reflective stage, these signs were connected to the psychological reality of isolated individuals during the pandemic, revealing love as an active response to existential alienation. At the ontological stage, love was found to operate as a way of being that transcends physical presence

title: A Needs Analysis for Developing the Project-Task Based Learning (PROTABING) Model in Indonesian Language Instruction
text_snippet: A Needs Analysis for Developing the Project-Task Based Learning (PROTABING) Model in Indonesian Language Instruction This study aims to analyze the need for developing a Project-Task Based Learning (PROTABING) poetry learning model in senior high schools to address the challenges of Indonesian language learning. Using a descriptive qualitative approach with a focus on needs analysis, this study involved 71 tenth-grade students and two Indonesian language teachers in Bukittinggi selected through purposive sampling. Data were collected through questionnaires, semi-structured interviews, and document analysis of learning tools using a checklist. The study findings revealed specific student barriers, including difficulty interpreting metaphorical meanings (88%), confusion in the use of figurative language (90.5%), and low self-confidence in oral appreciation (89%). Meanwhile, the analysis of the tools showed that although the teaching module had met administrative standards, the available evaluation instruments were not yet able to authentically measure higher-order thinking skills (HOTS). On the other hand, the majority of students' learning motivation was in the moderate category (67%), indicating the need for a more challenging learning model. title: Integration of Deep Learning Approaches and PjBL Models: Analysis of Students' Writing Skills Cycle Towards News Publication
text_snippet: Integration of Deep Learning Approaches and PjBL Models: Analysis of Students' Writing Skills Cycle Towards News Publication This study aims to analyze the effectiveness of the integration of the Deep Learning approach and the Project-Based Learning (PjBL) model in improving the news writing ability of high school grade XI students towards digital publications. The main problem of the study is the low critical reasoning and factual verification skills of students in conventional news text learning. The method used is Classroom Action Research (CAR) model Kemmis and McTaggart in two cycles. Data were collected through intensive observation, documentation, performance tasks, and interviews, which were analyzed using the interactive models of Miles, Huberman, and Saldaña. The results showed a significant improvement in students' writing skills, with classical completeness increasing from 20% in the pre-cycle to 53.33% in Cycle I,and reaching a peak of 90% at the end of Cycle II. Qualitatively, the integration of the Deep Learning dimension through personal coaching has successfully overcome students' literacy and technical barriers. title: Rhetorical Strategies in Political Campaign Banners: Language Use in the 2024 Election in Pekanbaru City
text_snippet: Rhetorical Strategies in Political Campaign Banners: Language Use in the 2024 Election in Pekanbaru City This study aims to analyze the rhetorical strategies employed in campaign banners of legislative candidates in the 2024 General Election in Pekanbaru City using the Aristotelian rhetorical framework of ethos, pathos, and logos. The study adopts a qualitative approach with a descriptive method based on textual analysis of the verbal and visual messages contained in campaign banners. Data were collected through stratified purposive sampling and analyzed to identify the forms, dominant tendencies, and implications of rhetorical strategy use in visual-based political campaigning. The findings indicate that ethos is the most dominant rhetorical strategy. Candidates’ credibility is constructed through the emphasis on personal identity, political track records, social and local affiliation, religious legitimacy, and narratives of integrity and leadership responsibility. Pathos functions as a supporting strategy manifested through political promises, personal and religious appeals, as well as creative humor to establish emotional closeness with voters. Meanwhile, logos appears in a limited and simplified form, primarily through references to technocratic capacity and institutional function

title: Analisis Pendekatan Ekspresif pada Lirik Lagu “Di Akhir Perang” Karya Nadin Amizah
text_snippet: Analisis Pendekatan Ekspresif pada Lirik Lagu “Di Akhir Perang” Karya Nadin Amizah Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengungkap ekspresi perasaan dan pengalaman batin pengarang dalam lirik lagu Di Akhir Perang karya Nadin Amizah dengan menggunakan pendekatan ekspresif. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kualitatif deskriptif dengan objek kajian berupa teks lirik lagu. Data penelitian berupa kata, frasa, dan kalimat yang mengandung unsur ekspresif, yang dikumpulkan melalui teknik dengar, simak, dan catat. Analisis data dilakukan dengan menafsirkan lirik lagu berdasarkan pendekatan ekspresif untuk memahami hubungan antara pengalaman batin pengarang dan makna yang dibangun melalui bahasa lirik. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa lirik lagu Di Akhir Perang merepresentasikan proses penyembuhan emosional, penerimaan diri, dan upaya berdamai dengan konflik batin. Metafora “perang” digunakan sebagai simbol pergulatan emosional yang berat, sementara diksi seperti perlahan, mewarnai, menerima, dan pulang menggambarkan proses pemulihan yang berlangsung secara bertahap dan membutuhkan kesabaran serta dukungan emosional. Lirik lagu tidak hanya menampilkan emosi sesaat, tetapi juga menunjukkan perubahan batin pengarang dari kondisi terluka menuju kedewasaan emosional dan ketenanga

title: Tindak Tutur Ekpresif Tokoh dalam Novel Aku Tak Membenci Hujan Karya Sri Puji Hartini
text_snippet: Tindak Tutur Ekpresif Tokoh dalam Novel Aku Tak Membenci Hujan Karya Sri Puji Hartini Tindak tutur ekspresif dalam karya sastra sering kali menjadi cermin dari intensitas konflik psikologis dan dinamika kekuasaan antar-tokoh. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis manifestasi dan fungsi tindak tutur ekspresif negatif, khususnya menyalahkan, mengkritik, dan mengeluh, dalam novel Aku Tak Membenci Hujan karya Sri Puji Hartini. Menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif deskriptif dengan kerangka analisis pragmatik, data dikumpulkan melalui teknik studi dokumenter dan dikodifikasi berdasarkan fungsi ilokusinya. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa tindak tutur menyalahkan didominasi oleh strategi dehumanisasi melalui metafora peyoratif untuk menghancurkan harga diri lawan tutur. Tindak tutur mengkritik ditemukan beroperasi melalui mekanisme sarkasme dan eksklusi sosial yang bersifat pasif-agresif. Sementara itu, tindak tutur mengeluh berfungsi sebagai gugatan eksistensial yang menuntut validasi atas pengabaian emosional. Secara kolektif, ketiga tindak tutur ini membentuk pola komunikasi toksik yang secara radikal melanggar prinsip kesantunan demi mencapai tujuan retoris dalam narasi. Penelitian ini memberikan kontribusi signifikan terhadap studi linguistik sastra dengan mengu

title: Efektivitas AI-Storylit dalam Meningkatkan Literasi Visual dan Computational Thinking Siswa Sekolah Dasar
text_snippet: Efektivitas AI-Storylit dalam Meningkatkan Literasi Visual dan Computational Thinking Siswa Sekolah Dasar Penelitian ini mengkaji pengaruh AI-StoryLIT, Interactive Digital Storybook berbasis kecerdasan buatan dengan fitur text-to-speech, image generation, dan adaptive feedback, terhadap literasi visual dan kemampuan computational thinking siswa kelas V sekolah dasar. Pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain kuasi-eksperimen pretest-posttest control group diterapkan pada 30 siswa SDN 1 Wonocoyo yang terbagi dalam kelompok eksperimen (n=15) dan kelompok kontrol (n=15). Instrumen tes telah divalidasi ahli (87,2%), dengan analisis menggunakan uji-t independen, N-Gain, dan effect size Cohen's d. Hasil menunjukkan peningkatan signifikan pada kelompok eksperimen. Literasi visual mencapai rerata posttest 84,38 (N-Gain 0,55; sedang) dibanding kontrol 72,12 (N-Gain 0,21; rendah), dengan effect size 1,21 (besar). Computational thinking mencapai rerata 82,75 (N-Gain 0,54; sedang) dibanding kontrol 70,18 (N-Gain 0,19; rendah), dengan effect size 1,34 (besar). Peningkatan tertinggi terjadi pada indikator interpretasi dan pengenalan pola. AI-StoryLIT terbukti menjadi alternatif strategis dalam pembelajaran abad ke-21 yang integratif dan adaptif di sekolah dasar.

title: Representasi Kearifan Lokal dalam Gaya Wacana pada Antologi Cerpen Presean Karya Hafazah Bukhari
text_snippet: Representasi Kearifan Lokal dalam Gaya Wacana pada Antologi Cerpen Presean Karya Hafazah Bukhari Kajian terhadap penggunaan bahasa dalam karya sastra memiliki peran penting dalam memahami dan melestarikan identitas budaya lokal dalam suatu masyarakat. Namun, masih sedikit penelitian yang secara spesifik menganalisis penggunaan alih kode dan campur kode dalam karya sastra berlatar budaya lokal, terutama dalam konteks budaya Sasak. Penelitian ini menyoroti bagaimana alih kode dan campur kode dalam antologi cerpen Presean karya Hafazah Bukhari memperkuat identitas budaya Sasak dan memperkuat estetika narasi. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kualitatif-deskriptif dengan teknik studi dokumentasi, sementara analisis data dilakukan melalui pendekatan stilistika dan analisis konten (content analysis) untuk memahami fungsi estetis dan budaya. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa alih kode digunakan untuk menonjolkan nilai tradisi, spiritualitas, dan filosofi masyarakat Sasak, sedangkan campur kode memperkaya deskripsi kehidupan sehari-hari, elemen adat, dan interaksi sosial khas budaya Sasak. Kedua elemen ini memberikan kontribusi signifikan dalam melestarikan nilai budaya lokal sekaligus memperkuat daya tarik estetis cerpen. Penelitian ini menegaskan bahwa karya sastra berperan penting

title: Bahasa Slang dan Identitas Generasi Z dalam Postingan Akun Instagram @sajak_detik: Kajian Sosiolinguistik
text_snippet: Bahasa Slang dan Identitas Generasi Z dalam Postingan Akun Instagram @sajak_detik: Kajian Sosiolinguistik Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis bentuk, fungsi, serta peran bahasa slang dalam pembentukan identitas Generasi Z pada postingan akun Instagram @sajak_detik berdasarkan kajian sosiolinguistik. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kualitatif dengan sumber data berupa 8 postingan Instagram yang diunggah pada periode Juni–Desember 2025, yang dipilih secara purposif karena mengandung unsur bahasa slang. Dari keseluruhan data tersebut, ditemukan kurang lebih 40 leksikon dan bentuk slang yang kemudian diklasifikasikan ke dalam lima kategori utama, yaitu campur kode bahasa Indonesia–Inggris, leksikon gaul (penggunaan kata gua/gue, ga, uda, ngapain, cape, muak banget, dan terserah deh), singkatan (misalnya HTS (Hubungan Tanpa Status)), pemendekan kata (seperti abis (dari habis), ajaa, benerr, nahhkann, cape-cape, dan ga), interjeksi/ekspresif, serta ungkapan khas Generasi Z (seperti eh, yap, deh, serta konstruksi reflektif seperti baik-baik aja versi aku atau capek tapi gak bisa berhenti). Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kualitatif dengan data berupa teks caption dan konten unggahan yang mengandung unsur bahasa slang. Teknik pengumpulan data meliputi membaca, mencatat, dan dokumen

title: AI-Storylit: Interactive Digital Storybook sebagai Media Literasi Visual Berbasis Kecerdasan Buatan di Sekolah Dasar
text_snippet: AI-Storylit: Interactive Digital Storybook sebagai Media Literasi Visual Berbasis Kecerdasan Buatan di Sekolah Dasar Perkembangan kecerdasan buatan (Artificial Intelligence) membuka peluang besar untuk menghadirkan inovasi media pembelajaran yang lebih adaptif, interaktif, dan menarik bagi siswa sekolah dasar. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengembangkan AI-StoryLIT, sebuah Interactive Digital Storybook berbasis kecerdasan buatan yang dirancang untuk memperkuat literasi visual dan kemampuan memahami bacaan siswa sekolah dasar. Penelitian menggunakan metode Research and Development (R&D) dengan model ADDIE (Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, and Evaluation). Subjek penelitian melibatkan 16 siswa kelas V di SDN 1 Gondang, kecamatan Tugu, kabupaten Trenggalek, serta 2 ahli materi dan 2 ahli media sebagai validator. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa: (1) media AI-StoryLIT memenuhi kriteria kevalidan dengan kategori sangat layak berdasarkan validasi ahli media (91%) dan ahli materi (87,2%); (2) media memenuhi kriteria kepraktisan dengan kategori sangat baik berdasarkan uji coba lapangan (89,06%); dan (3) media efektif meningkatkan pemahaman membaca dengan peningkatan skor rata-rata dari 64 menjadi 82 (peningkatan 28%), nilai N-Gain 0,50 (kategori sedang), serta ketuntasan belajar mencapai

title: Analisis Gaya Bahasa dan Nilai Pendidikan Karakter dalam Lirik Lagu “Bertaut” Karya Nadin Amizah: Kajian Stilistika
text_snippet: Analisis Gaya Bahasa dan Nilai Pendidikan Karakter dalam Lirik Lagu “Bertaut” Karya Nadin Amizah: Kajian Stilistika Sastra, khususnya lirik lagu, merupakan manifestasi ide pengarang yang merefleksikan kondisi sosial melalui bahasa estetis. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mendeskripsikan jenis dan fungsi gaya bahasa dalam lirik lagu "Bertaut" karya Nadin Amizah melalui kajian stilistika, serta mengungkap muatan nilai pendidikan karakter di dalamnya sebagai alternatif bahan ajar Bahasa Indonesia. Metode yang digunakan adalah kualitatif deskriptif dengan pendekatan teori stilistika Gorys Keraf. Dari hasil analisis, ditemukan total 13 data kutipan lirik yang memuat 7 jenis gaya bahasa dan 5 nilai karakter. Secara rincian, penggunaan gaya bahasa kiasan (simile, metafora, personifikasi) berfungsi mengonkretkan perasaan abstrak, sedangkan gaya bahasa retoris (hiperbola, antitesis, repetisi, asindeton) berperan memberikan penekanan emosional. Analisis juga menemukan lima nilai pendidikan karakter, yaitu: kasih sayang, tanggung jawab, resiliensi, kejujuran menerima diri, dan rasa syukur.
